note: The quirk the adapter exists to absorb: Groq answers a tokens-per-minute overage with HTTP 413. Classifying on the status alone yields ContextTooLong — failover-ineligible — and strands the request on an exhausted model while three others sit idle. The body's `code` is what makes it a RateLimited.
